name: get_guide
title: Read an Agentplane guide
description: Read one Agentplane workflow guide without a shell, HTTP client, or execution environment. Start with name="index", then fetch only the guide relevant to your task; use "session_delegation" for environment discovery, child Sessions, inputs, results and recovery. Returns the guide name and Markdown as structured content with the same JSON text fallback. This reads static documentation bundled with MCP Edge, performs no Action, and grants no access; discover current tools, schemas and policy separately. Follow a linked guide by its filename stem, such as get_guide(name="recovery").

name.description: Read index to choose a workflow, then request that guide by name.

name: list_actions
title: List Actions
description:
Discover available Action identifiers without loading their full schemas or descriptions.
Use this before get_action when the group/name is unknown; this never submits an Action.
Optionally filter by group, select input_schema/description, and resume with next_after.
Pages contain at most limit entries; backend addresses, credentials, and bindings are never returned.

items.description:
Optional fields of one Action's own definition/schema; include_fields on list_actions and
get_action is a pure allowlist over these.

name: get_action
title: Get Action
description:
Read one Action definition, not a submitted request or its execution status.
Provide group/name from list_actions; request input_schema before constructing unfamiliar arguments.
Full description and input_schema appear only when named in include_fields; defaults are compact.
Unknown names fail clearly; use get_action_request instead when you have a durable request ID.

items.description:
Optional fields of one Action's own definition/schema; include_fields on list_actions and
get_action is a pure allowlist over these.

name: get_action_policy
title: Get Action Policy
description:
Read what bindings auto-decide for a target: your own ("self", the default), or a named
ServiceAccount. include_fields is a pure allowlist over subject (self-target only), synced,
bindings, and auto_approve_if, defaulting to
subject/synced/bindings. Name auto_approve_if before request_action to learn which Actions and
arguments are approved without an operator -- each entry names the binding, set and index a
Decision's policy_evidence names; a request matching nothing waits for one, and until synced is
true nothing auto-decides. A target the service does not watch reads as no bindings. This never
submits an Action and says nothing about past Decisions; read those with get_action_request.

service_account.description:
One ServiceAccount, by namespace and name.

Namespaced because a subject is not always in the namespace enforcing it: an agent this cluster
does not host runs where it runs, and naming its namespace is how a binding reaches it.

items.description: Every top-level get_action_policy field; include_fields is a pure allowlist over these.

name: request_action
title: Request Action
description:
Submit one Action for policy evaluation, human decision if needed, and single-shot execution.
Supply a stable idempotency_key with structured action group/name, validated arguments, and a title the deciding operator reads.
Answers once wait ends as get_action_result would: a finished Action's own result exactly as its tool answered, otherwise what it waits on or why it has none. wait.wait_seconds (0 through this instance's configured maximum, default 0) optionally waits for wait.wait_until ("decision" or "terminal", default terminal).
respond_with="receipt" answers with a compact receipt (id, state, version, created_at, updated_at) instead. include_fields, for a receipt only, is a pure allowlist: input (the submitted idempotency_key/action/arguments/title/description as one unit), caller, caller_uid, decision, and execution (state, error and timing, never the result) widen it.
Pending is not success. A key this caller already used is refused; after response loss read the request with get_action_request or get_action_result(idempotency_key=...), never submit a new key.

request.description: The invariant caller envelope; no owner or decision-route branch is accepted.

title.description: One plain-language line saying what this request does, for the operator deciding it; commit-subject length, e.g. "delete crashlooping backend pod". Not the Action's group/name, which is shown already, and not a decision note, which the operator writes back when deciding.

description.description: Optional detail or justification the title leaves out, for the operator deciding; build on the title instead of restating it. Not the Action's group/name, and not a decision note, which the operator writes back when deciding.

wait_seconds.description: Capped by this instance's max_wait_seconds setting.

items.description: Every top-level Receipt field; include_fields is a pure allowlist over these.

respond_with.description: What request_action answers with once its wait ends.

name: get_action_request
title: Get Action Request
description:
Read your submitted Action's current receipt: its Decision and its execution's state and error; read the result with get_action_result.
Name the request by exactly one of the request ID returned by request_action or the idempotency_key you submitted it under; the key recovers a submission whose response was lost.
wait.wait_seconds (0 through this instance's configured maximum) optionally waits for wait.wait_until ("decision" or "terminal", default terminal); a deadline returns the current pending receipt.
Returns a compact receipt by default -- see request_action for what include_fields widens; request decision/execution once state is terminal to see how it ended.
This never submits, retries, or cancels execution, and other callers' requests are not readable.

anyOf.description: The idempotency_key this caller submitted the request under.

wait_seconds.description: Capped by this instance's max_wait_seconds setting.

items.description: Every top-level Receipt field; include_fields is a pure allowlist over these.

name: get_action_result
title: Get Action Result
description:
Read your Action's outcome as the tool it ran answered: its own content blocks, images included, and
structured content. No receipt carries the result.
Name the request by exactly one of request_id or idempotency_key, as for get_action_request.
wait.wait_seconds (0 through this instance's configured maximum) optionally waits for wait.wait_until ("decision" or "terminal", default terminal); until it finishes the result says what it waits on and is not an error.
Denied, cancelled, failed and unknown outcomes are error results; unknown means it may have run.
This never submits, retries, or cancels execution, and other callers' requests are not readable.

anyOf.description: The idempotency_key this caller submitted the request under.

wait_seconds.description: Capped by this instance's max_wait_seconds setting.

name: cancel_action_request
title: Cancel Action Request
description:
Withdraw your Action request only before its execution has been claimed for dispatch.
Provide the durable request ID; no version is required, and another caller's requests are inaccessible.
Returns cancelled, already_cancelled, already_finished, or too_late together with the current receipt, compact by default -- see request_action for include_fields.
Dispatching/running or unknown executions cannot be stopped; the cancelled receipt stays readable by request ID or idempotency key.

items.description: Every top-level Receipt field; include_fields is a pure allowlist over these.

name: list_action_request_events
title: List Action Request Events
description:
Read an ordered page of canonical state transitions for your Action request.
Start after_sequence at zero or at the last sequence already received; use next_after_sequence for more pages.
Each event carries its sequence, state, and timestamp; a caller actor includes its verified caller_uid when known. get_action_request provides the current receipt and result.
This read never submits or retries execution and cannot reveal another caller's events.
